title: Rehehehe Laugh
blurb: A scheming, nasal little laugh belonging to somebody whose plan benefits exactly one person. What makes it work is the pitch — genuine mirth sits lower, whereas this sits right up in the nose where mischief lives — and it announces intent before anything has actually been done. Play it when somebody takes the last slice with full knowledge of what they are doing, wins on a technicality nobody had noticed, or executes a prank they have clearly been saving for weeks. Petty victory has a soundtrack.
